build_xcit_upernet_config: build a config for XCiT medium 24-layer backbone with UPerNet head on ADE20K dataset
configure_xcit_backbone: configure XCiT backbone with patch_size=8, embed_dim=512, depth=24, and 8 attention heads
setup_upernet_decode_head: setup UPerNet decode head with 512-channel inputs and 150 ADE20K semantic classes
configure_adamw_optimizer: configure AdamW optimizer with lr=6e-5, weight_decay=0.01, and zero decay for position embeddings
setup_poly_lr_schedule: setup poly learning rate schedule with linear warmup over 1500 iterations for 160k training steps
